answer.reason: The verses give distinct deeds of Menahem beyond the summary: the sack of Tiphsah and the tribute paid to Pul.

clauses.english: smote Tiphsah and all in it because they did not open to him
clauses.quote: Menahem smote Tiphsah, and all that were therein

clauses.english: gave Pul king of Assyria a thousand talents of silver to confirm the kingdom in his hand
clauses.quote: Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver

doubts: The killing of Shallum in 2KI 15:14 is already in the summary, so it was left out.
The dataset's reign start and end events are only the summary's office, so they were not used.
